items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] sometimes who's with him now Lawrence who's with him he's Paul Barnes yeah well Paul Barnes been sick... [INTERVIEWEE] those Creole songs yeah well he's brother well they well died

ctx.x: What about his brothers? Did they play music?
Well, no. All his brothers are dead out. He had one brother named Paul, and another brother named Feast. Well, they all dead. My father and all of them died out. Feast, his name was?
